bsi.editorial_reason: Jeremiah 29:24,31,32 contains the Hebrew gentilicial adjective Nehelamite (נֶחֱלָמִי), not an independently attested proper name for a town. The form may describe a birthplace, family affiliation or a pun on the Hebrew for dreaming; no excavation or other biblical verse proves a locality Nehelam. Retain original source keys as qualified contextual witnesses, while removing the unsupported claim of an established geographic settlement from the public-facing English identity label.
